weeks.content:
Treat friends the way I love to be treated
Kindness to all children

Pray before we eat
Behave well in church or mosque

Finish my little tasks
Work before play

Be happy with what I have
Do not cry for everything

The story of the honest child
Truth brings trust

We are one class, one Nigeria
Play with every child

Help without being asked
Look around for little jobs

Let go of small hurts
Make peace before home time

Younger children copy me
Behave well always

Recite our moral rules
Award the kindest friend
